name: Entner-Doudoroff Pathway (Non-Phosphorylative)
notes: DEPRECATED: Consolidated into entner_doudoroff_network.json. This standalone version kept for reference. Non-phosphorylative Entner-Doudoroff pathway: gluconate => glycerate. Operates on completely unphosphorylated intermediates (gluconate → KDG → glyceraldehyde → glycerate). Distinguished by gnaD (gluconate dehydratase) and kdgA (KDG aldolase, EC 4.1.2.51) which cleaves non-phosphorylated KDG. Found in archaea (Sulfolobus, Thermoplasma, halophiles) and some bacteria. Includes downstream glyceraldehyde processing (cutA/B/C complex, gadh, or aor) to complete pathway to glycerate. KEGG M00309 starts with gluconate - upstream glucose activation is a separate pathway.

nodes.name: gluconate dehydratase
nodes.notes: Diagnostic enzyme for non-phosphorylative ED; dehydrates gluconate to KDG (2-keto-3-deoxy-gluconate)

nodes.name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate aldolase
nodes.notes: Diagnostic aldolase for non-phosphorylative ED; cleaves KDG (non-phosphorylated) to pyruvate and D-glyceraldehyde. Distinct from eda/kdpgA which require phosphorylated substrate.

nodes.name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-phosphogluconate aldolase
nodes.notes: Alternative aldolase for non-phosphorylative ED; can also cleave non-phosphorylated KDG

nodes.name: glyceraldehyde dehydrogenase complex (cutABC)
nodes.notes: Three-subunit complex: cutA (K18020, large), cutB (K18021, medium), cutC (K18022, small). All three subunits required for activity. KEGG: K18020+K18021+K18022

nodes.name: D-glyceraldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP+)
nodes.notes: Alternative glyceraldehyde dehydrogenase; uses NADP+ instead of complex. Single enzyme, not a complex.

nodes.name: aldehyde:ferredoxin oxidoreductase
nodes.notes: Alternative aldehyde oxidoreductase; uses ferredoxin as electron acceptor. Single enzyme, not a complex.

edges.notes: KDG intermediate - diagnostic for non-phosphorylative ED

scoring.notes: Core pathway (steps 1-2) required. Downstream processing (step 3) is optional - different organisms use different glyceraldehyde dehydrogenases. Step 3 has three alternatives: (1) cutABC complex (all three subunits K18020+K18021+K18022 must be detected), (2) gadh alone, or (3) aor alone. Diagnostic markers (gnaD + kdgA/kdpgA) distinguish non-phosphorylative ED from other pathways.
